data.title: Exein Raises $270m at $1.7bn Valuation to Build the Security Layer for Physical AI
data.description: Exein, a leading Physical AI cybersecurity firm, revealed a substantial investment of $270 million, bringing their total valuation to $1.7 billion. This funding marks Exein as the most valuable cybersecurity startup in Europe. The influx of capital will support Exein's expansion efforts in the US and APAC regions, as well as bolster their endeavors in Physical AI security. This specialized field focuses on safeguarding intelligent machines utilizing AI for perception, decision-making, and physical actions, encompassing robots, drones, and autonomous vehicles. In addition to their expansion plans, Exein is actively working on proprietary solutions aimed at enhancing cybersecurity measures in this domain.

data.title: TOYO Corporation Opens Its Quantum Computers to Japan's Ecosystem
data.description: IQM Quantum Computers, a prominent player in superconducting quantum computers based in ESPOO, Finland, revealed that TOYO Corporation has acquired their second complete quantum computer, IQM Spark. This acquisition marks an extension of TOYO's quantum capabilities and underscores IQM's dedication to advancing quantum technology in Japan. The latest addition, the Spark system, will be set up at TOYO's research and development facility in Kiba, Tokyo, and is expected to be functional by early 2027. This installation will facilitate direct engagement in fundamental quantum computing practices.
